author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before scattered the nodes diagonally: the gear sat top-left, with one box top-right and two bottom boxes on crossing links, so there was no hierarchy. Now a six-lobed gear sits at the top centre as the root, with a stem to the middle box and links to two outer boxes on one level, as in the reference.
omissions: The gear's hub ring (a hub needs valleys 8 away, which leaves no height for the chart on a 32-tall keyshape); the orthogonal bus (replaced by fan links).
